verdict.rationale: mise has a dedicated CI documentation page covering non-interactive install/setup (mise install, mise install --locked), a first-party GitHub Action (mise-action) wrapping installation and tool setup, reproducibility via lockfiles/pinned versions, and safety flags like MISE_SAFE=1 for non-interactive/trusted execution in pipelines. Community evidence corroborates real-world CI usage patterns (mise steps in GitHub Actions workflows). Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of CI runs or broader third-party CI platform examples beyond GitHub Actions.
